title: The Deep Gate Road
description: Scout Mira has heard the dwarves of Kargrim will pay for word of the fouled diggings, and their Deep Gate lies a hard march west along the low road. Carry the news yourself — a scout who knows both ends of a road is worth two who know one. The gate-warden will hear you out.

objectives.desc: Take the west road to the Kargrim Deep Gate
